# event interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventInterval`](gmeow-eventInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The crisp, known time interval over which an event occurred (reuses the temporal module's [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)). For a point-like occurrence use [`gmeow:eventTime`](gmeow-eventTime.md); for an approximate date use [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) / [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) + [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:eventInterval`](gmeow-eventInterval.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
